description: This file defines the ContainElementMatcher struct and its methods for matching elements within collections, used in testing assertions within the Gomega testing framework.

classes.name: ContainElementMatcher
classes.description: A matcher that checks if a collection contains an element matching a specified condition.

methods.name: Match
methods.description: Performs the matching logic to determine if the actual collection contains an element matching the specified element or condition.

methods.name: FailureMessage
methods.description: Returns the failure message when the match does not succeed.

methods.name: NegatedFailureMessage
methods.description: Returns the failure message when the negated match does not succeed.
